property.name: sourceMode
property.label: Render Source
property.description: How to read the JSON. 'fmtData' renders OmniScript's display-formatted answer set (OmniScriptFmtData) - only the form fields the user saw. 'raw' renders the raw payload tree (filtered by the header blocklist / Root Path / Exclude Keys). Falls back to raw if OmniScriptFmtData is missing.

property.name: jsonFieldName
property.label: JSON Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field on this record holding the application form JSON (e.g. Application_Form_JSON__c).

property.name: rootPath
property.label: Root Path (optional)
property.description: Dotted path to render from, e.g. PersonalDetails. Leave blank to render the whole payload (with the OmniScript header filtered out).

property.name: excludeKeys
property.label: Exclude Keys (optional)
property.description: Comma-separated extra top-level keys to hide, in addition to the known OmniScript header keys.

property.name: includeScalarSections
property.label: Include top-level simple fields
property.description: By default only object/list sections are shown (this hides the OmniScript metadata). Turn on to also show plain top-level fields.
